Intermediate.learningGoal: Protect shared mutable state with an actor and understand isolation.
gotchas: Actor methods are async from outside and may interleave at every await (reentrancy)
nonisolated members cannot touch isolated state
State read before an await may be stale after it
goodSolutionShows: Actor owning its state with no locks
Check-then-act done without an intervening await
Tests that hammer the actor from many tasks and assert exact totals
shapeHints: a bank account actor with transfer
a request deduplicator or in-flight cache
a counter or rate limiter with an injected clock

Advanced.learningGoal: Handle actor reentrancy and design Sendable value types.
gotchas: Reentrancy: two callers can both pass a cache-miss check before either stores the result
Sendable classes need immutability or internal synchronisation
@unchecked Sendable disables the compiler check, so correctness is on you
goodSolutionShows: Storing an in-flight Task in the actor to dedupe concurrent loads
Test with an injected loader counting invocations
shapeHints: an image or data cache deduplicating concurrent loads
a job queue actor with bounded concurrency

Expert.learningGoal: Design actor-based pipelines with isolation boundaries, global actors and reentrancy-safe ordering.
gotchas: Actor reentrancy: state can change across an await inside an actor method, so a check made before the suspension may no longer hold after it
Global actor annotations leak to closures
goodSolutionShows: Clear isolation boundaries with Sendable messages
Preserving order with an explicit sequence number
Deterministic tests that hold a method at its suspension point with a continuation to interleave a second call, instead of sleeping
shapeHints: a worker pool that returns results in submission order
an isolated registry with a snapshot API
